description: The person has a template open in the Opus Motion studio and gave you its session code (OM-XXXX-XXXX). Join it first: you get the draft their studio shows, its editToken and the next steps. Then change it with update_draft: each change appears in their studio within seconds, and what they change there is in the draft when you read it. Never make a new draft for a session, and don't hand over a link: they have it open.

code.description: The session code from the person's prompt, for example OM-7KQ2-X4PD.

name: join_studio_session
title: Join the person's open studio
